central_question: What does a renewing short-lived Desktop token protect, and what remains exposed after credential theft?
claims_and_limits: GitHub announced the gradual rollout on November 2 for Desktop 3.6.10+ and eligible github.com/GHE Cloud accounts.
Existing signed-in sessions do not automatically migrate; GHES is unsupported.
No universal exact lifetime or independently measured incident reduction is provided. Token expiry does not prove a compromised device safe.

visual.shared_motif: Amber desktop key and hourglass; inner timeline explains sign-in, token use, refresh, stolen-token window and rollout scope.
visual.status: Conceptual threat-model timeline without a fabricated expiry duration.
